# scc_multi_tenant_organization_config (Resource)

Manages the MultiTenantOrganizationConfig configuration via Set-MultiTenantOrganizationConfig.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `identity` (String) Identity of the existing object whose configuration is managed.

### Optional

- `add_authorized_member_tenants` (Set of String) Maps to the -AddAuthorizedMemberTenants parameter.
- `authorized_owner_tenant_for_member_tenant` (String) Maps to the -AuthorizedOwnerTenantForMemberTenant parameter.
- `is_multi_tenant_organization_enabled` (String) Maps to the -IsMultiTenantOrganizationEnabled parameter.
- `remove_authorized_member_tenants` (Set of String) Maps to the -RemoveAuthorizedMemberTenants parameter.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Object identifier (GUID).
